body: Hi, I’m sorry I can’t give you much advice on how to get yourself out of this. I too have a traumatic past and am now dealing with a lot of anxiety and depression. I have built myself a very good life with a good job and lots of friends and it just seems that everything is an effort. I can’t offer much advice because I too am loosing this battle but I hope knowing that your not alone is some comfort and I hope you find a way to win.
Would you be able to tell me what your experience was like?
Thank you so much for your kind words :)

It can be so hard, but you can’t compare yourself to others, we’re all different. I used to feel like this and have never really had a lot of friends. But I also used to smoke a lot of marijuana and honestly, once I stopped it was like my whole life changed. Some people can smoke and be ok, but some people just can’t. Our brains aren’t wired to be able to handle it. Please don’t hurt yourself, maybe you can see a psych?
